description: Shorti(쇼티) for «make my version of this» or «이걸로 내 버전 만들어줘». A person's own AI version of a hit made for them, its framing, light and sound kept, labelled AI. Keyless it starts nothing: it says how, and names the hit's page, where the first needs no account, and the way their own AI makes it free.
name: shorti_make

link.description: Where its owner watches, keeps and posts the clip.

state.description: sign_in_to_make, coming, making, a stage of the job, ready, refused or not_run.

title: Your clip, made by AI
